        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_48/test_13.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_48/test_14.csv"
    ]

    # Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
    dfs = []
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path, usecols=['sub_grade'])
        # Ensure sub_grade is integer type
        df['sub_grade'] = df['sub_grade'].astype(int)
        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all source DataFrames vertically (union all rows)
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # The target schema is just ['sub_grade'] as integer, so no further transformation needed
    # But ensure the dtype is integer
    combined_df = combined_df.astype({'sub_grade': 'int'})

    # Write the combined DataFrame to the target CSV file
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_48/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    combined_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
